name: L10 PanoLab three-producer pixel-unseen lexical-then-appearance replay
question: Can the unchanged exact-token temporal branch recover the two safe appearance UNKNOWNs without creating a wrong-target conflict on the three-producer panel?
observed_before_freeze: The sealed appearance result was 1 correct, 0 wrong, 2 UNKNOWN. Human review had exposed readable Direction de la Culture and Creche des p'tits Lutins signage, while Eglise Saint-Pierre had no obvious name sign. No OCR output, normalized token, confidence, token-bank match, or lexical route had been observed on any of the nine query images.

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

routing_contract.lexical: Run the exact frozen PP-OCRv6 medium entrance-window pipeline and long-short exact-token bank across prev/anchor/next for every one of the eleven roster names.
routing_contract.unique_own_match: If and only if the requested target is the sole matched roster name, emit TEMPORAL_EXACT_TOKEN_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE.
routing_contract.no_match: Reuse the already sealed temporal appearance candidate or UNKNOWN without recomputation or threshold changes.
routing_contract.unique_wrong_or_multiple_matches: Return UNKNOWN_LEXICAL_CONFLICT_KEEP_SEARCHING; never let appearance override a lexical conflict.
routing_contract.authority: All emitted candidates remain SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY with no portal-ownership binding.
routing_contract.no_adaptation: No OCR model, confidence rule, normalization, target spelling or alias, long-short split, token rule, crop, image, producer stratum, roster, fallback, or gate may change after output.

required: three pixel-unseen sequences, three producer strata and nine frames evaluated
at least +2 correct over the sealed 1/3 appearance branch
0 wrong-target exact-token matches across 30 counterfactual trials
gate.failure_policy: Preserve the first result. Do not tune target aliases, token rules, OCR settings, images or strata.

research_basis.title: GoMatching++: Parameter- and Data-Efficient Arbitrary-Shaped Video Text Spotting and Benchmarking
research_basis.use: Motivates accumulating text evidence over multiple observations. This router uses a frozen deterministic exact-token bank, not GoMatching++.

research_basis.title: GloTSFormer: Global Video Text Spotting Transformer
research_basis.use: Motivates retaining global historical text evidence. This replay does not implement its Transformer.

claim_boundary.allowed: Pixel- and OCR-unseen Development evidence about whether the already fixed exact-token temporal branch complements or safely defers to the sealed appearance branch on exactly three target-way/item-disjoint Caen targets spanning three capture producers in one same-provider eleven-target closed roster.
not_allowed: blind or independent adjudication, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment confirmation
a same-name OCR token proving exact entity identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, or portal ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
